name: WGEYSER_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 0: anim STAND; Update: catches the Wolf or the out-of-zone sheep in the water (inferred)

name: WGEYSER_ST_WHIRL_IN
meaning: SetState 2: anim WHIRL (0 if the Wolf is dead) (inferred)

name: WGEYSER_ST_WHIRL
meaning: SetState 3: sound 0x131, msg 0x31 to the passenger, anim WHIRL1 (inferred)

name: WGEYSER_ST_WHIRL_OUT
meaning: SetState 4: anim WHIRL2; Update: sheep -> 5, Wolf to the out-geyser (inferred)

name: WGEYSER_ST_SHEEP_OUT
meaning: SetState 5: anim WHIRL2; Update: msgs 0x2886/0x2880 to the GeyserOut (inferred)
